```{=html}
<div class="fp-cards">

    <div class="fp-trend-large" id="fp-trend-label">—</div>
    <div class="fp-card-sub" id="fp-trend-sub"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="fp-card">
    <div class="fp-card-label">Epidemic level</div>
    <div class="fp-level-line">
      <span class="lbl">Current:</span>
      <span class="val" id="fp-level-current">—</span>
    </div>
    <div class="fp-level-line">
      <span class="lbl">In 4 weeks:</span>
      <span class="val" id="fp-level-future">—</span>

    <div class="fp-card-sub" id="fp-peak-week-sub"></div>

      <h3>ED Visits Forecast</h3>
      <div class="sub"><span class="fp-h-label">4-week</span> ahead projection • Data source: NSSP</div>
    </div>

    <div class="fp-legend-item"><span class="fp-legend-swatch" style="background:#94a3b8"></span> Last year (2024-2025)</div>
    <div class="fp-legend-item" style="color:#2563eb"><span class="fp-legend-swatch dash"></span> Ensemble forecast (100 simulated trajectories)</div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const resp = await fetch("data/forecast_prototype_data.json", { cache: "no-cache" });
  if (!resp.ok) {
    document.getElementById("fp-chart").innerHTML =
      `<div style="padding:24px;color:#b91c1c">Failed to load forecast data (${resp.status}). ` +
      `If you're viewing this via file://, serve the directory over HTTP (e.g. <code>quarto preview</code>).</div>`;
    return;
  }
  const DATA = await resp.json();
  const MODEL_COLORS = { Ensemble: "#2563eb", GAM: "#9333ea", Baseline: "#0d9488" };

  const state = {
    region: null,
    viewMode: "trajectories",
    enabledModels: new Set(["Ensemble"]),
  };

  const QUANTILE_LEVELS = [0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975];
  const N_TRAJ_DRAWS = 30;  // how many sample paths to render in trajectories view

  // Default region: prefer Texas if present, else first.
  const defaultLoc = DATA.locations.find(l => l.id === "texas") || DATA.locations[0];
  state.region = defaultLoc.id;

  // Populate region dropdown
  const regionSel = document.getElementById("fp-region");
  for (const loc of DATA.locations) {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = loc.id;
    opt.textContent = loc.name;
    if (loc.id === state.region) opt.selected = true;
    regionSel.appendChild(opt);
  }
  regionSel.addEventListener("change", e => { state.region = e.target.value; render(); });

  // View mode toggle
  document.querySelectorAll("#fp-viewmode button").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.viewMode = btn.dataset.v;
      document.querySelectorAll("#fp-viewmode button").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
      render();
    });
  });

  // Static labels
  document.getElementById("fp-ref-date").textContent = DATA.reference_date;
  document.getElementById("fp-season-label").textContent = DATA.season_label;

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function weekOfYear(dateStr) {
    const d = new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00Z");
    const start = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
    const diff = (d - start) / 86400000;
    return Math.floor((diff + start.getUTCDay()) / 7) + 1;
  }
  function quantileInArray(arr, val) {
    if (!arr.length) return null;
    const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    let count = 0;
    for (const x of sorted) if (x <= val) count++;
    return Math.round((count / sorted.length) * 100);
  }
  function ordinal(n) {
    if (n == null) return "—";
    const s = ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"], v = n % 100;
    return n + (s[(v - 20) % 10] || s[v] || s[0]);
  }
  function quantilesOf(values, levels) {
    if (!values.length) return levels.map(() => null);
    const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    return levels.map(p => {
      const i = p * (sorted.length - 1);
      const lo = Math.floor(i), hi = Math.ceil(i);
      return sorted[lo] + (sorted[hi] - sorted[lo]) * (i - lo);
    });
  }
  function quantileBandsByDate(samples) {
    // samples: [[w1,w2,...wN], ...]; returns {q025, q25, q50, q75, q975} arrays of length N
    if (!samples.length) return null;
    const N = samples[0].length;
    const out = { q025: [], q25: [], q50: [], q75: [], q975: [] };
    for (let t = 0; t < N; t++) {
      const col = samples.map(s => s[t]);
      const [q025, q25, q50, q75, q975] = quantilesOf(col, [0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975]);
      out.q025.push(q025); out.q25.push(q25); out.q50.push(q50);
      out.q75.push(q75); out.q975.push(q975);
    }
    return out;
  }
  function historicalSeasonPeaks(history) {
    // Group observations by flu season (Aug 1 → Jul 31) and return {season, peak, date} per season.
    if (!history || !history.length) return [];
    const byseason = {};
    for (const r of history) {
      if (r.value == null) continue;
      const y = parseInt(r.date.slice(0, 4));
      const m = parseInt(r.date.slice(5, 7));
      const seasonYear = m >= 8 ? y : y - 1;
      if (seasonYear >= 2025) continue;
      if (!(seasonYear in byseason) || r.value > byseason[seasonYear].peak) {
        byseason[seasonYear] = { season: seasonYear, peak: r.value, date: r.date };
      }
    }
    return Object.values(byseason);
  }
  function levelCategory(pct) {
    // pct = percentile (0-100) of value vs same-week historical observations
    if (pct == null) return { label: "—", color: "#64748b" };
    if (pct >= 90) return { label: "Far above average", color: "#b91c1c" };
    if (pct >= 66) return { label: "Above average",     color: "#c2410c" };
    if (pct >= 33) return { label: "Average",           color: "#475569" };
    if (pct >= 10) return { label: "Below average",     color: "#15803d" };
    return                  { label: "Far below average", color: "#166534" };
  }
  function peakStatsFromSamples(samples, dates) {
    // For each sample, find its argmax: returns {peakValues, peakDates}
    const peakValues = [], peakDates = [];
    for (const s of samples) {
      let bestI = 0, best = s[0];
      for (let i = 1; i < s.length; i++) { if (s[i] > best) { best = s[i]; bestI = i; } }
      peakValues.push(best);
      peakDates.push(dates[bestI]);
    }
    return { peakValues, peakDates };
  }
  function trace(name, x, y, opts = {}) {
    return Object.assign({ type: "scatter", mode: "lines+markers", name, x, y }, opts);
  }

  // ---------- render ----------
  function render() {
    const loc = DATA.locations.find(l => l.id === state.region);
    const observed = DATA.observed_current[state.region] || [];
    const prior = DATA.observed_prior[state.region] || [];
    const history = DATA.history[state.region] || [];
    const forecasts = DATA.forecasts[state.region] || {};

    const ensemble = forecasts.Ensemble;
    const lastObs = observed.length ? observed[observed.length - 1].value : null;
    const lastObsDate = observed.length ? observed[observed.length - 1].date : null;

    // ---- Card 2: Epidemic level (colored categories, vs 2015-2025 same-week) ----
    const levelCurEl = document.getElementById("fp-level-current");
    const levelFutEl = document.getElementById("fp-level-future");
    const levelSubEl = document.getElementById("fp-level-sub");
    const histValuesForWeek = (wk) => history.filter(r => r.value != null && Math.abs(weekOfYear(r.date) - wk) <= 1).map(r => r.value);
    let nSeasonsUsed = 0;
    if (lastObs != null && lastObsDate) {
      const wk = weekOfYear(lastObsDate);
      const histVals = histValuesForWeek(wk);
      nSeasonsUsed = histVals.length;
      const p = quantileInArray(histVals, lastObs);
      const cat = levelCategory(p);
      levelCurEl.textContent = cat.label;
      levelCurEl.style.color = cat.color;
    } else {
      levelCurEl.textContent = "—"; levelCurEl.style.color = "";
    }
    if (ensemble && ensemble.samples.length) {
      const h4Idx = 3;
      const h4Median = quantilesOf(ensemble.samples.map(s => s[h4Idx]), [0.5])[0];
      const futureDate = ensemble.dates[h4Idx];
      const wk = weekOfYear(futureDate);
      const histVals = histValuesForWeek(wk);
      const p = quantileInArray(histVals, h4Median);
      const cat = levelCategory(p);
      levelFutEl.textContent = cat.label;
      levelFutEl.style.color = cat.color;
    } else {
      levelFutEl.textContent = "—"; levelFutEl.style.color = "";
    }
    levelSubEl.textContent = nSeasonsUsed
      ? `Comparing to ${nSeasonsUsed} same-week observations from 2015-2025`
      : "";

    // ---- Card 1: Epidemic trend (P wk2>wk1, colored label + rise-count sub) ----
    const trendLabelEl = document.getElementById("fp-trend-label");
    const trendSubEl = document.getElementById("fp-trend-sub");
    const fmtMd = ds => {
      const d = new Date(ds + "T00:00:00Z");
      return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
    };
    if (ensemble && ensemble.samples.length && ensemble.dates.length >= 2) {
      const n = ensemble.samples.length;
      const nUp = ensemble.samples.filter(s => s[1] > s[0]).length;
      const pct = Math.round(nUp / n * 100);
      let label, fg;
      if (pct >= 85)      { label = "Increasing";        fg = "#b91c1c"; }
      else if (pct >= 65) { label = "Likely increasing"; fg = "#c2410c"; }
      else if (pct >= 35) { label = "Uncertain";         fg = "#475569"; }
      else if (pct >= 15) { label = "Likely declining";  fg = "#15803d"; }
      else                { label = "Declining";         fg = "#166534"; }
      trendLabelEl.textContent = label;
      trendLabelEl.style.color = fg;
      trendSubEl.textContent = `${nUp} of ${n} trajectories rise from ${fmtMd(ensemble.dates[0])} → ${fmtMd(ensemble.dates[1])}`;
    } else {
      trendLabelEl.textContent = "—"; trendLabelEl.style.color = "";
      trendSubEl.textContent = "";
    }

    // ---- Card 3 (Expected peak week) + Card 4 (Expected season peak) ----
    const peakWeekEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-week");
    const peakWeekSubEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-week-sub");
    const peakWeekHistEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-week-hist");
    const peakValEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-value");
    const peakVsLastEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-vs-last");
    const peakVsLastProbEl = document.getElementById("fp-peak-vs-last-prob");

    if (ensemble && ensemble.samples.length) {
      const stats = peakStatsFromSamples(ensemble.samples, ensemble.dates);
      const [pvLo, pvMd, pvHi] = quantilesOf(stats.peakValues, [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]);
      const histPeaks = historicalSeasonPeaks(history);
      const fmt = ds => {
        const d = new Date(ds + "T00:00:00Z");
        return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
      };

      // --- Card 3: peak week ---
      const dateCounts = {};
      for (const d of stats.peakDates) dateCounts[d] = (dateCounts[d] || 0) + 1;
      const modeDate = Object.keys(dateCounts).reduce((a, b) => dateCounts[a] >= dateCounts[b] ? a : b);
      const sortedPeakDates = [...stats.peakDates].sort();
      const loIdx = Math.floor(0.25 * (sortedPeakDates.length - 1));
      const hiIdx = Math.floor(0.75 * (sortedPeakDates.length - 1));
      peakWeekEl.textContent = fmt(modeDate);
      peakWeekSubEl.textContent = `50% PI: ${fmt(sortedPeakDates[loIdx])} – ${fmt(sortedPeakDates[hiIdx])}`;

      if (histPeaks.length) {
        // Normalize calendar weeks around the new year so wraparound averages correctly:
        // late-year weeks (e.g. week 50) shift to negative (-2), Jan weeks stay positive.
        const normalize = w => w >= 27 ? w - 52 : w;
        const histWeeksNorm = histPeaks.map(p => normalize(weekOfYear(p.date)));
        const meanHistWeek = histWeeksNorm.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / histWeeksNorm.length;
        const forecastWeek = normalize(weekOfYear(modeDate));
        const diffWeeks = forecastWeek - meanHistWeek;
        let text, color;
        if (diffWeeks <= -2.5)        { text = `~${Math.round(Math.abs(diffWeeks))} weeks earlier than usual`; color = "#c2410c"; }
        else if (diffWeeks <= -0.75)  { text = "Slightly earlier than usual"; color = "#c2410c"; }
        else if (diffWeeks < 0.75)    { text = "About the same time as usual"; color = "#475569"; }
        else if (diffWeeks < 2.5)     { text = "Slightly later than usual"; color = "#ca8a04"; }
        else                          { text = `~${Math.round(diffWeeks)} weeks later than usual`; color = "#ca8a04"; }
        peakWeekHistEl.textContent = text;
        peakWeekHistEl.style.color = color;
        peakWeekHistEl.style.fontWeight = "600";
      } else {
        peakWeekHistEl.textContent = "";
      }

      // --- Card 4: peak comparison (primary) + value (secondary) ---
      const lastSeasonPeakObj = histPeaks.find(p => p.season === 2024);
      if (lastSeasonPeakObj) {
        const lastPk = lastSeasonPeakObj.peak;
        const deltaPct = (pvMd - lastPk) / lastPk * 100;
        let dirLabel, dirColor, dirWord, probDir;
        if (deltaPct >= 0) {
          dirWord = "higher";
          probDir = stats.peakValues.filter(v => v > 1.20 * lastPk).length / stats.peakValues.length;
        } else {
          dirWord = "lower";
          probDir = stats.peakValues.filter(v => v < 0.80 * lastPk).length / stats.peakValues.length;
        }
        if (Math.abs(deltaPct) <= 20) { dirLabel = "Similar to last year";  dirColor = "#475569"; }
        else if (deltaPct > 20)       { dirLabel = "Higher than last year"; dirColor = "#b91c1c"; }
        else                          { dirLabel = "Lower than last year";  dirColor = "#15803d"; }
        peakVsLastEl.textContent = dirLabel;
        peakVsLastEl.style.color = dirColor;
        peakValEl.textContent = `Forecast peak: ${pvMd.toFixed(1)}% (last yr: ${lastPk.toFixed(1)}%)`;
        peakVsLastProbEl.textContent = `${Math.round(probDir * 100)}% chance peak is more than 20% ${dirWord} than last year`;
      } else {
        peakVsLastEl.textContent = "Last season unavailable";
        peakVsLastEl.style.color = "#94a3b8";
        peakValEl.textContent = `Forecast peak: ${pvMd.toFixed(1)}%`;
        peakVsLastProbEl.textContent = "";
      }
    } else {
      peakWeekEl.textContent = "—"; peakWeekSubEl.textContent = ""; peakWeekHistEl.textContent = "";
      peakValEl.textContent = "—"; peakVsLastEl.textContent = "—"; peakVsLastProbEl.textContent = "";
    }

    // ---- Chart ----
    const traces = [];

    // Observed (current season)
    const obsX = observed.map(r => r.date);
    const obsY = observed.map(r => r.value);
    traces.push(trace("Observed", obsX, obsY, {
      line: { color: "#0f172a", width: 2.5 },
      marker: { color: "#0f172a", size: 5 },
      showlegend: false,
    }));

    // Prior season — shift forward 52 weeks
    if (prior.length) {
      const priorAligned = prior
        .filter(r => r.value != null)
        .map(r => {
          const d = new Date(r.date + "T00:00:00Z");
          const shifted = new Date(d.getTime() + 52 * 7 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
          return { date: shifted, value: r.value };
        });
      traces.push(trace("Last year", priorAligned.map(r => r.date), priorAligned.map(r => r.value), {
        line: { color: "#94a3b8", width: 1.8 },
        marker: { color: "#94a3b8", size: 3 },
        showlegend: false,
        opacity: 0.7,
      }));
    }

    // Forecasts (per enabled model)
    for (const m of DATA.models) {
      if (!state.enabledModels.has(m)) continue;
      const f = forecasts[m];
      if (!f || !f.samples.length) continue;
      const color = MODEL_COLORS[m];
      const x = f.dates;

      if (state.viewMode === "intervals") {
        const bands = quantileBandsByDate(f.samples);
        // 95% band
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
          x: [...x, ...x.slice().reverse()],
          y: [...bands.q975, ...bands.q025.slice().reverse()],
          fill: "toself", fillcolor: color + "26",
          line: { color: "transparent" },
          name: `${m} 95%`, hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false,
        });
        // 50% band
        traces.push({
          type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
          x: [...x, ...x.slice().reverse()],
          y: [...bands.q75, ...bands.q25.slice().reverse()],
          fill: "toself", fillcolor: color + "4D",
          line: { color: "transparent" },
          name: `${m} 50%`, hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false,
        });
        // Median, connected to last observed point
        let connX = x, connY = bands.q50;
        if (lastObs != null) {
          connX = [lastObsDate, ...x];
          connY = [lastObs, ...bands.q50];
        }
        traces.push(trace(m, connX, connY, {
          mode: "lines",
          line: { color, width: 2.5, dash: "dash" },
        }));
      } else {
        // Trajectories: draw N_TRAJ_DRAWS individual sample paths
        const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(f.samples.length / N_TRAJ_DRAWS));
        const indices = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < f.samples.length; i += step) indices.push(i);
        indices.forEach((idx, j) => {
          let lineX = x, lineY = f.samples[idx];
          if (lastObs != null) {
            lineX = [lastObsDate, ...x];
            lineY = [lastObs, ...f.samples[idx]];
          }
          traces.push({
            type: "scatter", mode: "lines",
            x: lineX, y: lineY,
            line: { color, width: 1 },
            opacity: 0.25,
            name: j === 0 ? m : `${m} draw`,
            showlegend: j === 0,
            hoverinfo: "skip",
          });
        });
      }
    }

    const layout = {
      margin: { t: 10, r: 20, b: 50, l: 50 },
      xaxis: {
        type: "date",
        showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#eef2f7",
        tickfont: { size: 11, color: "#64748b" },
        title: { text: "" },
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: { text: "ED Percent Flu", font: { size: 12, color: "#475569" } },
        showgrid: true, gridcolor: "#eef2f7",
        tickfont: { size: 11, color: "#64748b" },
        rangemode: "tozero",
      },
      legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: 1.12, font: { size: 11 } },
      plot_bgcolor: "#fff",
      paper_bgcolor: "#fff",
      shapes: [{
        type: "line", xref: "x", yref: "paper",
        x0: DATA.reference_date, x1: DATA.reference_date, y0: 0, y1: 1,
        line: { color: "#cbd5e1", width: 1, dash: "dot" },
      }],
      annotations: [{
        x: DATA.reference_date, xref: "x", y: 1.02, yref: "paper",
        text: "Forecast date", showarrow: false,
        font: { size: 10, color: "#94a3b8" },
      }],
    };

    Plotly.react("fp-chart", traces, layout, { displayModeBar: false, responsive: true });
  }

  // Initial labels
  document.querySelectorAll(".fp-h-label").forEach(el => el.textContent = `${state.horizon}-week`);
  render();
})();
</script>
```
